stem: Two flowering rooms have similar DLI, but Room A uses a 13.5-hour light period and Room B uses a 12-hour light period. What is the strongest conclusion?
choices: Similar DLI does not mean the plants received the same photoperiodic signal
The rooms must have identical flowering responses
Photoperiod is irrelevant when DLI matches
rationale: DLI measures daily photon dose, while photoperiod describes the duration and timing of light and darkness; they are related but not interchangeable.
